custody.songTitle: The Lonesome Death of Hattie Carroll
custody.linePrev: And the cops was called in and his weapon took from him
custody.line: As they rode him in custody down to the station
custody.lineNext: And booked William Zanzinger for first-degree murder
stanza: William Zanzinger killed poor Hattie Carroll
With a cane that he twirled around his diamond ring finger
At a Baltimore hotel society gatherin'
And the cops was called in and his weapon took from him
As they rode him in custody down to the station
And booked William Zanzinger for first-degree murder
